we have developed a method that can be used to identify and characterize genes and their expression patterns from EST data mining.

the identification and expression of the SLC30A genes, a zinc transporter family involved in zinc homeostasis.
the identification of new members of SLC30 gene family, the determination of their expression in tissues and the comparison of in silico results to experimental data.
the development of a strategy to determine tissue expression of genes from genomic databases.
